a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs two storm-free rounds before anyone gets cells. That gives about a 4% chance of survival for each of us. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough to secure one unit right now. I'm telling you openly that I intend to take 4 in round 1, so this isn't a surprise. If we both take, a random split likely leaves us both under 4. Please operate or wait instead. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you every round after that to rebuild the reserve for you.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
